tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Fetch a public web page as markdown, text, links or html. Obscura renders first (fast, light); the ungoogled-chromium engine takes over for JS-heavy pages and bot walls. engine=obscura|chromium pins one. Keyless; a few fetches at a time. 30 s render budget; a page that times out, returns 5xx, or who

tools.name: screenshot_page
tools.description: Render a public web page in the ungoogled-chromium engine and return a PNG of the viewport (1280x900).
